title: Beta 1 (v0.1.1)
notes:
This is the first test version of the Windows desktop app. Please use it alongside your normal process and check every slip before you rely on it. The original single-file HTML app is unchanged and still works.

## What's in it

- **OT slips read from WMT.** "Read pay period from WMT" reads the Worksheet View and makes Full Shift, Front, End and Front & End OT slips. Anything it can't turn into a slip waits in "Needs attention".
- **Shift Change slips by hand**, with the same five slip types, wording and print layout as before.
- **Roster and Shift Legend from WMT** (area TPA). Changes are shown before they're applied, and new or removed entries wait in "Needs review".
- **Checks** for past dates and duplicate slips, a print preview, and the option to edit a slip before printing.
- **History** of every printed slip, which you can search and reprint from.
- **Shared data** (roster, shifts, history) in the Slip Generator folder on the Watch Desk share, with daily backups on your PC.
- **Update notices.** The app can tell you when a new version is out, and always asks before you install anything.

## Installing

1. Download the `setup.exe` file under "Assets" below and run it. It installs for you only, with no admin rights needed.
2. Windows SmartScreen will warn that the app is unrecognized, because it isn't signed. Choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
3. The installer asks whether to check for new versions automatically. Yes checks each time the app opens; No checks only when you press **Check for updates** in Settings. You can change this later.
4. The first time the app opens, it asks for the shared folder: the Slip Generator folder on the Watch Desk share. Ask Joey for the address.
5. In **Settings**, enter your FAA email and password for WMT. The password is kept in Windows Credential Manager. You can also leave it blank and sign in with your PIV card when the WMT window appears.

Reading the WMT Employee list needs a WMT account with admin access.

## Known limits

- Shift Change slips are still typed by hand.
- New versions are downloaded in your browser and installed by running the downloaded file; the app doesn't install them itself.

## Reporting problems

Tell Joey what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened. A screenshot helps. Please don't send saved WMT pages, because they contain a sign-in token and real names.
